name: Opik configurable equality scoring
description: Opik Equals capability in the dataset evaluation workflow. The default compares str-converted, lowercased values; case_sensitive=true changes that policy. These comparison options cannot repair or validate an original case-sensitive contract payload. This is a source-only component capability profile, not a dataset selection, measured result, model or data permission, contract-validity result or deployment gate. See research/T6-deployment-operations/evaluation.md.
